channel.title: Microsoft for Education Daily
channel.description: The latest Microsoft updates for schools, universities and TAFEs in three minutes, every morning, with who each update is for, its status and its sources. An independent recap, not an official Microsoft channel.

item.title: EP.015 · LOOK BEFORE YOU LEAP.
item.description: Manchester pilots Microsoft 365 Copilot before every student gets it, Word flags fake headings for Insiders, and Power Pages admins get per-site sign-in controls in preview.

item.title: EP.014 · ONE STEP AT A TIME.
item.description: The week's best for education: a study finds revealing slides step by step helps students find the point, passkey-first sign-in rolls out in Entra, and Kimi K3.1 Pro arrives in Foundry.

item.title: EP.013 · EVERYONE IN.
item.description: The week's best for education: Narrator reads math on Braille displays for Insiders, Live captions follows your mic, and App Blocks rolls out in Copilot Chat.

item.title: EP.012 · PLAN AHEAD.
item.description: Plan ahead: Microsoft 365 Education gets a new lineup from A0 to A7 and Microsoft Classroom, with most changes at renewals from January 2028.

item.title: EP.011 · PAUSE AND QUESTION.
item.description: Pause and question: 2,000 Filipino teachers are set to earn AI literacy credentials, Behind the Chat helps teens think twice, and Teams Rooms is due to show two screens at once.

item.title: EP.010 · LEARN BY DOING.
item.description: Learn by doing: a Wisconsin college trains data centre technicians with Microsoft, VS Code lets agents check each other's work, and Teams' Facilitator is due to turn meetings into slides.

item.title: EP.009 · ROOM TO LEARN.
item.description: Room to learn: Windows gets snappier on 8 GB PCs, an Ontario board opens Copilot's Study and Learn to Grades 9-12, and Imagine Cup keeps a category for students.

item.title: EP.008 · SAFE TO LEARN.
item.description: Safe to learn: US districts can add Microsoft's AI privacy standard, Study and Learn's locked mode is coming, and campus IT has time zones and fixes to check.

item.title: EP.007 · SHOW YOUR WORK.
item.description: The week's best for education: Elevate Showcase schools show their work, Edge PDF tools are on the way, and school IT gets new controls.

item.title: EP.006 · PLAN AHEAD.
item.description: The week's best for education: multi-week unit plans in Teach, previews to line up, and a January deadline for school IT.
